csv_project_name: AE for Six School Sites Signage Replacement
csv_scope_of_work: School District Five of Lexington and Richland Counties is seeking competitive sealed proposals from qualified vendors to provide design, fabrication, removal, disposal, delivery, and installation of interior and exterior signage at six (6) school sites. The work includes both replacement of existing signage and installation of new signage in accordance with the specifications herein. Project Plana. Provide a detailed explanation regarding how the Scope of Work will be performed and how all specifications will be met. Offeror shall discuss those attributes of their proposal that clearly and succinctly states how the Contractor proposes to meet or exceed the requirements of the RFP if selected as the Contractor. b. Provide a statement describing the Offeror s ability to mobilize and perform the required work, including an implementation plan and project timeline with key milestones and anticipated completion dates. The District anticipates that a substantial portion of the work will be completed prior to the start of the 2026 2027 school year to include the exterior signage for Chapin Middle School, CrossRoads Middle School and Spring Hill Middle School. Offerors should clearly identify how they will meet this schedule and any assumptions affecting project completion. c. Provide any additional information considered essential to the proposal which has not been specifically requested. d. Describe any additional optional services that may benefit the District that must follow the general scope of the project. Please limit statements to one page per service. e. Describe any additional benefits the District will realize through a contract with your firm.
